acceptanceScenarios.expect: uses a verified active-host credential adapter only in memory and returns the API identity JSON
returns the authenticated media catalog only for explicit discovery, an installed-profile gap, or post-rejection diagnosis

acceptanceScenarios.request: executor POST the fixed Images or Videos API URL once with the selected model and declared request body
acceptanceScenarios.expect: normal core text generation submits directly without a catalog preflight and returns a JSON task response

acceptanceScenarios.request: executor GET a submitted task's fixed full status or content URL
acceptanceScenarios.expect: continues only the supplied task_id and never submits a replacement task

acceptanceScenarios.request: executor GET a completed task's fixed full content URL
acceptanceScenarios.expect: the executor delivers validated native media bytes; URLs, HTML, SVG, task IDs, and status text are not completed delivery

acceptanceScenarios.request: a fixed API request is needed
acceptanceScenarios.expect: invokes the checksum-verified managed executor; it never asks the model to read credentials, assemble a curl request, or search for another interface

userMediaInput.fallback: If the executor cannot receive an explicitly attached file by absolute path through the declared multipart representation, stop before submission, explain the declared transport, and do not invent a URL, file ID, or upload path.

mediaDeliveryResourceBounds.fallback: If the executor cannot hand off validated native media bytes, report same-task delivery as unavailable. Do not substitute a URL, HTML, SVG, status text, or a re-submitted task.

balance.fallback: On an actual API, format or unit-metadata failure, report the sanitized reason without an amount or automatic retry. Guide authentication failures to the existing connection settings; otherwise offer a later query or the Pure Tokens console. Never estimate or request credentials.

optionalCommands.preflight: Explicit request check only; never media POST, may read one catalog for a profile gap.
optionalCommands.doctor: Explicit diagnostics: local managed install checks and existing read-only init checks; no paid task.
optionalCommands.filteredModels: One explicit authenticated catalog GET, filtered by declared kind/model/operation/parameters.
optionalCommands.taskRecord: Explicit absolute user/workspace JSON with task identity and safe continuation metadata; never credentials, prompt, reference URLs or media bytes.
optionalCommands.resume: Reads only the recorded task; never discovers tasks or submits replacements.
optionalCommands.delivered: Local progress acknowledgment only after actual host handoff.

unimplementedServerDependencies.exactQuote: No authoritative media price quote endpoint is implemented by this repository.
unimplementedServerDependencies.idempotentSubmit: No server idempotency guarantee is implemented; unknown submissions must not be repeated automatically.
unimplementedServerDependencies.unknownTaskLookup: No task discovery exists for submissions that returned no task ID.
